sn43.12:1.1: i. Serenity “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the unconditioned and the path leading to the unconditioned.
sn43.12:1.4: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion:
sn43.12:1.6: “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:1.8: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….
sn43.12:1.9: “Thus, bhikkhus, I have taught you the unconditioned and the path leading to the unconditioned….
sn43.12:1.11: This is our instruction to you.”
sn43.12:2.6: “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:2.8: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:3.1: iii–viii. Concentration iii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:3.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:3.4: iv … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:3.5: Concentration without thought, with examination only….”
sn43.12:3.7: v … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:4.1: vi … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:4.4: vii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:4.7: viii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:4.8: Undirected concentration: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:5.1: ix–xii. The four establishments of mindfulness ix … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:5.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating the body in the body, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world:
sn43.12:5.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:5.4: x … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:5.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating feelings in feelings, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world….”
sn43.12:5.7: xi … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:5.8: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating mind in mind, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world….”
sn43.12:5.10: xii … “And what, bhikkhus is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:5.11: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu dwells contemplating phenomena in phenomena, ardent, clearly comprehending, mindful, having removed covetousness and displeasure in regard to the world: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:6.1: xiii–xvi. The four right strivings xiii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:6.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu generates desire for the nonarising of unarisen evil unwholesome states; he makes an effort, arouses energy, applies his mind, and strives:
sn43.12:6.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:6.4: xiv … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:6.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu generates desire for the abandoning of arisen evil unwholesome states; he makes an effort, arouses energy, applies his mind, and strives….”
sn43.12:6.7: xv … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:6.8: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu generates desire for the arising of unarisen wholesome states; he makes an effort, arouses energy, applies his mind, and strives….”
sn43.12:6.10: xvi … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:6.11: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu generates desire for the continuance of arisen wholesome states, for their nondecay, increase, expansion, and fulfilment by development; he makes an effort, arouses energy, applies his mind, and strives: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:7.1: xvii–xx. The four bases for spiritual power xvii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:7.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the basis for spiritual power that possesses concentration due to desire and volitional formations of striving:
sn43.12:7.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:7.4: xviii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:7.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the basis for spiritual power that possesses concentration due to energy and volitional formations of striving….”
sn43.12:7.7: xix … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:7.8: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the basis for spiritual power that possesses concentration due to mind and volitional formations of striving….”
sn43.12:7.10: xx … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:7.11: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the basis for spiritual power that possesses concentration due to investigation and volitional formations of striving: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:8.1: xxi–xxv. The five spiritual faculties xxi … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:8.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the faculty of faith, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release:
sn43.12:8.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:8.4: xxii–xxv … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:8.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the faculty of energy …
sn43.12:8.14: the faculty of wisdom, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:9.1: xxvi–xxx. The five powers xxvi … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:9.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the power of faith, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release:
sn43.12:9.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:9.4: xxvii–xxx … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:9.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the power of energy …
sn43.12:9.14: the power of wisdom, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:10.1: xxxi–xxxvii. The seven factors of enlightenment xxxi … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:10.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release:
sn43.12:10.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:10.4: xxxii–xxxvii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:10.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops the enlightenment factor of discrimination of states …
sn43.12:10.10: the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:11.1: xxxviii–xlv. The Noble Eightfold Path xxxviii … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:11.2: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right view, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release:
sn43.12:11.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned….”
sn43.12:11.4: xxxix–xlv … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.12:11.5: Here, bhikkhus, a bhikkhu develops right intention …
sn43.12:11.15: right concentration, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release:
sn43.12:11.16: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned.
sn43.12:11.17: “Thus, bhikkhus, I have taught you the unconditioned and the path leading to the unconditioned.
sn43.12:11.18: Whatever should be done, bhikkhus, by a compassionate teacher out of compassion for his disciples, desiring their welfare, that I have done for you.
sn43.12:11.19: These are the feet of trees, bhikkhus, these are empty huts. Meditate, bhikkhus, do not be negligent, lest you regret it later. This is our instruction to you.”
